# Quadrant chart syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-quadrant/grammar/quadrant.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Quadrant chart syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `quadrantChart` diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF and CR read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read
as `='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities read as
opaque text (letters outside ASCII); and a line break appended. Keywords are matched without
regard to case.

Statements end at a line break, `;` or the end of the text. Text is a run of letters, digits,
blanks and most punctuation, or a quoted string; it never holds `:`, and outside quotes
`( ) < > [ ] { } @ ^ ~ |` are errors. Labels are trimmed.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A chart is `quadrantChart`, then statements, one per line.

```ebnf
quadrantChart = { eol | SPACE } Header document ;
```

```ebnf
Header @Header = QUADRANT ;
```

```ebnf
document = { { SPACE } [ statement ] eol } ;
```

```ebnf
eol = NEWLINE
    | SEMI
    | EOF ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Title
          | AccTitle
          | AccDescr
          | Axis
          | Quadrant
          | Point
          | ClassDef ;
```

`title <text>`: the chart title, the rest of the line.

```ebnf
Title @Title = title title_value ;
```

`accTitle: …`: the accessible title of the chart.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = acc_title acc_title_value ;
```

`accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description of the chart.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = acc_descr acc_descr_value
                   | acc_descr_multiline_value ;
```

`x-axis Low --> High` or `y-axis Low --> High`: an axis's labels, start then end. One label,
or one label and `-->`, set the start only.

```ebnf
Axis @Axis = ( X_AXIS | Y_AXIS ) text [ AXIS_TEXT_DELIMITER [ AxisEnd ] ] ;
```

```ebnf
AxisEnd @AxisEnd = text ;
```

`quadrant-1 <text>` … `quadrant-4 <text>`: a quadrant's label. Quadrant 1 is the top
right, 2 the top left, 3 the bottom left and 4 the bottom right.

```ebnf
Quadrant @Quadrant = ( QUADRANT_1 | QUADRANT_2 | QUADRANT_3 | QUADRANT_4 ) text ;
```

`Name: [x, y]`, with x and y from 0 to 1: a point, with optional styles such as
`radius: 10, color: #ff0000`. `Name:::class: [x, y]` gives it a class.

```ebnf
Point @Point = text [ class_name ] point_start point_x point_y [ styles ] ;
```

`classDef <name> <styles>`: a class of point styles, given with `:::name`.

```ebnf
ClassDef @ClassDef = CLASSDEF SPACE className SPACE styles ;
```

```ebnf
className = ( ALPHA | NUM | MINUS | COMMA | COLON | AMP | BRKT | MULT | UNICODE_TEXT )+ ;
```

Styles: `radius: <n>`, `color: <hex>`, `stroke-color: <hex>` and `stroke-width: <n>px`,
separated by `,`.

```ebnf
styles = style { COMMA style } ;
```

```ebnf
style = ( ALPHA | NUM | COLON | SPACE | BRKT | MINUS )+ ;
```

Text: a word, a quoted string or a markdown string, then more words, blanks and `-`.

```ebnf
text = ( textStart | STR | MD_STR ) { textStart | SPACE | MINUS } ;
```

```ebnf
textStart = PUNCTUATION
          | AMP
          | NUM
          | ALPHA
          | COMMA
          | PLUS
          | EQUALS
          | MULT
          | DOT
          | BRKT
          | UNDERSCORE
          | UNICODE_TEXT ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `title`, `acc_title`, `acc_descr`, `acc_descr_multiline`, `md_string`, `string`, `class_name`, `point_start`, `point_x`, `point_y`.

Every rule ignores case: a rule for `ab` also matches `AB` and `aB`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | — | `%%(?!\{)[^\n]*` |  | A `%%` comment after other text on a line, to the end of the line; it takes the character before it. |
| INITIAL | — | `[^}]%%[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NEWLINE | `[\n\r]+` |  | Line breaks, `;` and the end of the text end a statement. |
| INITIAL | — | `%%[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | title | `title\b` | push(title) | `title <text>`: the chart title, the rest of the line. |
| title | title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_title | `accTitle\s*:\s*` | push(acc_title) | `accTitle: …` and `accDescr: …` take the rest of the line; `accDescr { … }` runs to `}`. |
| acc_title | acc_title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_descr | `accDescr\s*:\s*` | push(acc_descr) |  |
| acc_descr | acc_descr_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `accDescr\s*\{\s*` | push(acc_descr_multiline) |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | — | `\}` | pop |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | acc_descr_multiline_value | `[^}]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | X_AXIS | `[ ]*x-axis[ ]*` |  | The axis and quadrant keywords take the spaces around them, so they are found anywhere on a line. |
| INITIAL | Y_AXIS | `[ ]*y-axis[ ]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | AXIS_TEXT_DELIMITER | `[ ]*--+>[ ]*` |  | `-->` (two or more dashes): between an axis's two labels. |
| INITIAL | QUADRANT_1 | `[ ]*quadrant-1[ ]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | QUADRANT_2 | `[ ]*quadrant-2[ ]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | QUADRANT_3 | `[ ]*quadrant-3[ ]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | QUADRANT_4 | `[ ]*quadrant-4[ ]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | CLASSDEF | `classDef\b` |  | `classDef <name> <styles>`: one blank after the keyword. |
| INITIAL | — | `"`` | push(md_string) | Strings: `"…"` (no escapes; it may span lines and is never empty) and markdown strings `` "`…`" ``. |
| md_string | MD_STR | `[^`"]+` |  |  |
| md_string | — | ``"` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `"` | push(string) |  |
| string | — | `"` | pop |  |
| string | STR | `[^"]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `:::` | push(class_name) | `Name:::class: [x, y]`: the class name follows `:::` directly. |
| class_name | class_name | `\w+` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | point_start | `\s*:\s*\[\s*` | push(point_start) | `: [x, y]`: a point's coordinates, each `0`, `1` or `0.` and digits (the `.` is any character). |
| point_start | point_x | `1\|0(?:.\d+)?` | push(point_x) |  |
| point_start | — | `\s*\][ ]*` | pop |  |
| point_x | — | `\s*,\s*` | pop push(point_y) |  |
| point_y | point_y | `1\|0(?:.\d+)?` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | QUADRANT | `[ ]*quadrantChart[ ]*` |  | `quadrantChart`: starts a quadrant chart; statements follow, one per line. |
| INITIAL | ALPHA | `[A-Za-z]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | UNICODE_TEXT | `[^\x00-\x7F]+` |  | Letters outside ASCII: CJK, accented Latin, emoji and the like. |
| INITIAL | COLON | `:` |  |  |
| INITIAL | PLUS | `\+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL | EQUALS | `=` |  |  |
| INITIAL | MULT | `\*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | BRKT | `#` |  |  |
| INITIAL | UNDERSCORE | `_` |  |  |
| INITIAL | DOT | `\.` |  |  |
| INITIAL | AMP | `&` |  |  |
| INITIAL | MINUS | `-` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NUM | `[0-9]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SPACE | `\s` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SEMI | `;` |  |  |
| INITIAL | PUNCTUATION | `[!"#$%&'*+,\-.`?\\_\/]` |  |  |
| INITIAL | EOF | `$` |  | The end of the text. |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
